recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, urban-themed composition featuring a central female figure in luxury streetwear leaning against a black SUV. The scene is set at night in an industrial area, characterized by dramatic lens flares, warm street lighting, and a gritty yet polished texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject dominance over the luxury vehicle
Contrast between soft fur textures and hard metallic surfaces
Warm golden highlights against cool dark shadows
Integration of large-scale script typography across the mid-ground
coreInvariants: Full-length fur coat draped to the ground
Black SUV with prominent chrome detailing
Industrial brick building with lit windows in the background
High-intensity lens flare on the vehicle headlight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full-body shot, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large script lettering in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the fur coat, across the large script title, and settles on the vehicle details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures and objects, using the dark sky and vehicle body as resting points.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays (SUV and shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (fur coat and skin tones).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and gold (lens flares, jewelry, and text outlines).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with saturated warm tones against desaturated dark backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a flowing, high-contrast script with thick downstrokes and thin connectors
Secondary text uses a stylized, wide-set geometric sans-serif with custom ligatures
Heavy use of drop shadows and metallic gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters in script feature exaggerated flourishes and loops
Small caps used for secondary titles to maintain horizontal block feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Calligraphic script paired with a futuristic, wide-tracked sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar formal script weight and flourish potential
Matches the wide, industrial feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion urban night scene. A woman in a floor-length brown fur coat, black leather corset, and hat stands in front of a glossy black luxury SUV. The setting is a gritty industrial street with a brick building and a bright lens flare coming from the car's headlight. Lighting is warm and dramatic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, gold-metallic script title across the center, overlapping the car. Add a secondary line of text below in a wide, futuristic sans-serif font. Ensure all text has a white outer stroke and a soft drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the fur texture highly detailed?
Does the lens flare appear naturally integrated?
Is the text legible despite the complex background?
Is the color palette consistent with early 2000s urban aesthetics?

adjustableVariables: Length and volume of the fur coat
Specific model of the luxury vehicle
Degree of metallic sheen on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the car
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light interaction between the flare and the subject's coat.
Ensure the typography does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the industrial background has a gritty, film-grain texture.
Confirm the gold tones in the text match the jewelry on the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Luxury Streetwear Subject] + [High-End Vehicle] + [Industrial Night Setting] + [Metallic Script Overlays] to achieve a classic urban-glamour aesthetic.
